summary: make_hex_tiles.py builds the finale's hex-tile library to the v2 contract: renders/hex_tiles/<id>/h_0001..0180.png (1152x998, 16-bit sRGB, flat-top hex inscribed, frame k = finale frame k with loops/holds resolved), c_painting/still.png (2544x2204, 16-bit), manifest.json (version 2 schema) and the contact sheet. Source priority final -> preview (Lanczos x2) -> labelled placeholder, never mixed inside a tile; a frame counts only if it ends with IEND and decodes; atomic directory swaps (renameat2 RENAME_EXCHANGE, two-rename fallback); lock file; idempotent (content signatures, metadata-only refresh); one process pool. Current state (last run 2026-11-20T16:14:48): the 6 chapter tiles are from v1 finals; c_s04_gallery uses the documented fallback renders/final/s04_every_dot (v1, identical f1-30) because renders/final/s04_subject does not exist yet; the centre still is the S04 preview overscan (1272x1102, Lanczos x2); the 12 minis are labelled placeholders because no mini has a complete preview or final yet (their previews on disk are sparse test frames).

rerun.finals queue (render_finals.py --film v2: cd /home/qzhao/render_demo && tools/venv/bin/python -I scripts/make_hex_tiles.py --require-final  # exit 0 = every tile and the centre are from finals; exit 2 = lists what is not final (it still builds everything it can, so the manifest is current); the S05 final guard reads manifest.json all_final / per-tile source

other flags.--only id,id: build only these tiles (ids, or c_painting for the centre); the manifest still lists every tile on disk
other flags.--placeholder-only: every selected tile and the centre as placeholders
other flags.--dry-run: resolve sources and print the source table; writes nothing
other flags.--print-plan <id>: per-frame source map of one tile (e.g. 109 0.143*f1 + 0.857*f175)
other flags.--force: rebuild even when up to date

contract.tile_png: 1152x998, 16-bit RGB, sRGB-encoded; flat-top hexagon inscribed: vertices (0, 499) and (1152, 499), flat edges y = 0 and y = 998
contract.screen_uv: flat-top screen hexagon of circumradius R centred at the origin (x right, y up): u = 0.5 + x / (2 R), v = 0.5 + y / (2 R * 998 / 1152); the centre still uses the same mapping with 2544 x 2204 (v = 0.5 + y / (2 R * 2204 / 2544))
contract.chapter_crop: a 1247.08 x 1080 window (the flat-top hex spanning the frame height) at centre (cx, 540) of the 1920x1080 frame, one Pillow Lanczos resample with an exact sub-pixel box to 1152x998 (cross-fades are mixed before the resample); previews use the same box scaled by 0.5
contract.mini: final 1152x998 16-bit RGB frames are byte-copied (after a decode check); other sizes (preview 576x499) Lanczos to 1152x998; meta loop L (2..180) -> tile frame k = source ((k-1) mod L) + 1 (needs only frames 1..L), loop null -> 180 straight frames
contract.centre: renders/final/s04_subject/overscan.png byte-copied if 2544x2204 16-bit, else preview overscan Lanczos x2, else placeholder = the painting scan with the overscan geometry from renders/meta/s04_subject.json (uv_rect, mirror_above_v, pingpong_band_v), falling back to the storyboard_v2 section 2 numbers
contract.manifest_extras: besides the schema fields every tile entry carries source_dir, dir, first, cyclic (true only if frame 180 -> 1 wraps seamlessly), palette_hex, ground, title, note, deviation, resample, meta_bg; top level: all_final, missing, hex, screen_uv, frame_rule. SOURCE.json per tile adds the full per-frame map and the signature
